title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Ruth Eckerd Hall, Clearwater | 2017
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Ruth Eckerd Hall in Clearwater, Florida, USA, on 10 November 2017.

It was the 16th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s US tour, which lasted for 21 dates in October and November 2017.

Starr had previously performed at the Ruth Eckerd Hall on 18 May 1997, 7 July 2006, 2 July 2008, 13 July 2010, 1 July 2012, and 23 October 2014. He returned there on 16 September 2022.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
